output.prompt: Evening wide shot of the Time Traveller’s laboratory: a man with gleaming grey eyes and flush cheeks leans on trouser pockets holding a metal frame, leading Filby (red-haired, argumentative-looking) seated behind another figure through flickering light down a draughty corridor into a room dominated by a larger machine of nickel and rock crystal; unfinished crystalline bars lie beside sheets of drawings under an atmosphere of incredulous wonder and fascination with mechanical complexity.
